name: Forced displacement
summary: IOM says over 300,000 fled fighting in western Yemen over two months; no new event above 500,000 in a month found
state: IOM said on 1 Nov that more than 300,000 people had fled fighting between Houthi and government forces in western Yemen, nearly all within the past two months (Khaleej Times, citing AFP). That pace is below the 500,000-in-a-month Watch line. Searches on 15 Nov found no other new event displacing more than 500,000 people this month, so Normal is kept.
for_you: Large displacements tend to raise needs for shelter, food and health care in neighbouring areas. FCDO travel advice covers the countries affected.
rubric_hit: Normal: no new event displacing >500,000 in a month (western Yemen ~300,000 over two months, IOM)
